crime: {WITCH_NAME} had told one girl she could not sleep in the dark. Before the weekly stream, she watched from the lounge doorway as the girl traded that secret for a place among the prisoners around the fireplace.

When the others went to the recreation room, {WITCH_NAME} approached the girl with her magic active. Seeing her most trusted person, the girl followed her to the empty lounge. There, {WITCH_NAME} took a sword from the wall to show her and stabbed her through. She wiped it and returned it to its hooks.
The prisoners found the body after the stream. Every sword was in place, but one had a smear left at the guard.

Two girls who had passed the pair on their way to the stream each named a different companion. Both named prisoners had watched the entire broadcast. The witnesses had seen two trusted faces on one person. Only {WITCH_NAME} and the dead girl had missed the stream.
fields.epitaph: Every door opened, and none of them opened for her.
fields.epithet: Dearest to Everyone, Known to No One
execution: Three huge iron bells stood mouth down, with her beneath one of them. Mechanical arms shuffled them, and a hammer fell on one bell after each round. The shuffling and blows continued until the hammer struck the bell containing her and crushed her beneath it.

magic.name: the Dearest Face
magic.text: The Dearest Face — Everyone who looks at her sees the person they trust most.
